docs.message:
docs: Oliver Jägle is the sole platform owner

## Intent

Ralf D. Müller wants to work only on the apps themselves (Mathe-Karte), not on the platform. The business model and the platform design still named both organisation owners as jointly accountable for the platform.

## Key changes

- biz42 chapter 8 names Oliver Jägle as the only platform owner. Ralf stays the second owner of the GitHub organisation and focuses on the apps.
- The owner id is owner-platform instead of owner-vorstand; all objectives and products refer to it.
- The evidence table records the new fact and marks the old one (two owners with equal rights) as superseded and open.
- In E2, E3 and E5 "the owners' observations" become the platform owner's. E2 lists Ralf among the app creators; E3 attributes biz42 and pdt42 to the platform owner and arc42 to docToolchain.
- The development plan adds KD-09: the owner role in D1 holds only Oliver Jägle.

## Dependencies and side effects

- GOVERNANCE.md and ORGANIZATION.md in lernapps/.github still name two owners with equal rights.
